messages:
mira: FYI dropped the CobaltWave LoRA merge onto staging ~1h ago and ran the tiny smoke pack. Seeing a clear currency/numeric regression when we use the int4 runtime. int8 and fp16 look fine.

mira: Minimal repro from the smoke run:
```
prompt: "Invoice total: $1,234.56"
fp16: "Invoice total: $1,234.56"
int8: "Invoice total: $1,234.56"
int4 (merged): "Invoice total: $123.456"  // decimal shifted
```

mira: Quick aggregate (50 examples, metric: numeric_exact_match): fp16=96%, int8=95%, int4=61%. Failures concentrated on thousands separators and cents tokens.

tomas: ouch. does base model (no LoRA) int4 show the same drop?

mira: ran base->int4 earlier, it was ~93% (small expected degradation). So the adapter merge seems to interact badly with our int4 quant path.

amir: probable cause: LoRA deltas increase per-weight dynamic range; quantizer saturates or rounds non-uniformly. Did you try lowering LoRA alpha or merging with a float cast before quant?

mira: Not yet. Pushed an eval command so others can reproduce locally:
```
# reproduce locally
rwd eval run --suite cobaltwave-smoke-v1 --model staging/cobaltwave-adapter:merged-int4 --output ./out.json
```

priya: Can you post tokenized forms of a couple fails? want to rule out tokenization splitting digits weirdly.

mira: Two failing samples + tokens:
- "Invoice total: $1,234.56" -> [Invoice,total,:,,$,1,,,234,.,56]
- "Amount due: $9,875.00" -> model outputs "$987.5"
Tokens look OK, output shows mantissa shift.

amir: sounds like kernel-level rounding. Try merging with alpha=0.7 and alpha=0.5 and also the merge-with-clip codepath (clips small deltas) we added last quarter.

mira: kicked off two re-merges: job 3001 (alpha=0.7) and job 3002 (alpha=0.5). will run same smoke suite and post numbers.

(eval-bot): Job 3001 (alpha=0.7) started on staging-int4.

(eval-bot): Job 3001 finished: numeric_exact_match=72% on int4. Int8 unchanged at ~95%.

(eval-bot): Job 3002 (alpha=0.5) finished: numeric_exact_match=87% on int4. improvement but still gap vs fp16. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/cobaltwave/3002/

priya: nice progress. can you isolate which prompts still fail at alpha=0.5? maybe a pattern by magnitude or punctuation.

mira: filtered fails -> almost all have comma thousands separators and two decimals. small integers (no comma) pass. suggests rounding noise interacts with token boundaries at comma.

amir: plan: 1) try merge-with-clip + alpha=0.6; 2) consider short-term post-process that normalizes currency spans if they parse oddly (coerce scale).

mira: launched job 3003 (merge-with-clip, alpha=0.6).

(eval-bot): Job 3003 finished: numeric_exact_match=90% on int4. remaining failures: 8/50, reproducible.

tomas: 90% + a post-process seems acceptable for a customer canary. propose: promote merged-alpha-0.6 to staging-canary, enable a customer-scoped post-process that normalizes currency tokens, monitor for 24h, rollback on any customer-visible regression. @mira can you prepare the canary config? @priya set up monitoring?

mira: I'll prepare canary manifest and include a minimal repro bundle for CS.

priya: I'll create the monitoring checks: numeric_exact_match, token-diff histogram, and error-rate on currency spans. I'll attach eval artifacts to the rollout ticket.

jen: CS update: customer currently sees ~20 mismatches in their tests. I'll share the canary plan and ETA (aiming 3-4hrs after we push). request: feature-flag the post-process so we can toggle quickly.

mira: Will implement the post-process as a feature-flagged handler per-customer. Not ideal long-term but buys time. Filed RW-12134 with details and s3 links.

amir: follow-up: engineering should audit quant params used in the merge codepath vs base model quant codepath; mismatch there can explain asymmetric errors. also add unit tests for numeric token preservation across quantized merges.

mira: good note. i'll add the audit checklist to the ticket.

(eval-bot): Canary job deployed to staging-canary with merged-alpha-0.6 and customer post-process enabled. Monitoring hooks added.

mira: posting final artifacts and canary link once smoke-run completes in the canary env. thanks everyone.
